worldcombat.skill.stickyweb.summary: Toss a wad of silk at a chosen patch of ground so it spreads into a web: a grounded foe that steps in loses a Speed stage and is stuck in the web for a while, and the drag is kept up while it stays. It deals no damage - it only slows foes down. Airborne bodies pass above it. The anchored form drops one more stage and sticks longer but lays smaller; the wide form covers more ground, faster, for one stage only.
worldcombat.skill.stickyweb.use.0: Turn a patch of ground into a slow zone ahead of time
worldcombat.skill.stickyweb.use.1: Snare a foe that charges or flees
worldcombat.skill.stickyweb.use.2: Cut the mobility of a fast target
A grounded foe that steps in loses %1$s of Speed and is stuck for %2$s; for Pokemon this is the native Speed stage, for vanilla and modded bodies the movement-speed attribute. Airborne bodies are not caught.
The web is about %1$s blocks wide and stays for %2$s; a foe that stays inside keeps the drag, and one that leaves walks it off over the remaining time.
worldcombat.skill.stickyweb.option.on: Anchored on: one more Speed stage and a longer stick and web life, but the web narrows to about 0.8x, +2 ticks wind-up and a longer cooldown - for sealing one narrow path.
worldcombat.skill.stickyweb.option.off: Anchored off (wide): the web lays about 1.25x wider, is faster to lay with a shorter cooldown, at one stage and a shorter stick - for covering a wide patch.
worldcombat.skill.stickyweb.timing: Throw the web at a point within %1$s: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.stickyweb.preference.a: On: one more Speed stage and a longer stick and web life, but the web narrows to about 0.8x, +2 ticks wind-up and a longer cooldown. Off: the wide form lays about 1.25x wider, is faster to lay with a shorter cooldown, at one stage and a shorter stick.
The partner only considers laying on a threat this close; smaller keeps it for nearby ground, larger seeds the path ahead.
Lead a moving target by this many ticks; 0 lays on its current spot, larger suits stopping a charging foe.
